title: Syntari rendered screen review
description: What a visual review adapter returns for a rendered screen: observations against the composition criteria, each tied to a criterion, with the region of the screenshot it is about. It is a judgment, not validation: Syntari labels it as such and never merges it into diagnostics.

source.description: Who reviewed: a model name, a person, a tool.

criterion.description: A criterion id from lint.criteria in composition-policy.json, such as responsive or surface-economy.

node.description: The node id it is about, when the adapter can tell.

region.description: Where in the screenshot, in CSS pixels.
